answers.q1: Maven, using the bundled wrapper (the repo also has a Gradle build, but CI's Maven workflow uses ./mvnw). Install dependencies with: ./mvnw -B dependency:go-offline
answers.q2: ./mvnw -B test (CI runs the full build with ./mvnw -B verify, which includes the tests plus the format and checkstyle validation)
answers.q4: ./mvnw -B validate. This runs spring-javaformat:validate and the nohttp checkstyle check, both bound to the validate phase, and CI's ./mvnw -B verify runs them too. To auto-fix formatting, run ./mvnw spring-javaformat:apply.
answers.q5: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is generated from src/main/scss/*.scss by the 'css' Maven profile (libsass), so edit the SCSS instead. target/ and build/ are build output. .gradle, .idea and .settings are IDE or tool state. Don't hand-edit the wrapper files (mvnw, mvnw.cmd, gradlew, gradlew.bat, .mvn/wrapper/, gradle/wrapper/), and src/main/resources/static/resources/fonts/ holds vendored font files. No node_modules or vendor directories are checked in.
